scope: bounded Nukumanu-area probe; tagged building/highway ways and place nodes only; no completeness claim
population_status: population tags retained when present; no missing population is converted to zero
snapshot_hash_convention: UTF-8 text with LF newlines and no BOM
metric: spherical LAEA feature intersections in the bounded probe; lengths in projected metres
unmeasured: global feature totals, relation buildings, completeness, population, shipping and air routes
